evals.title: Collective credit, role calibration, and outcome distinctions
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx makes Jamie's direct actions inspectable: he built public campaign web infrastructure, stewarded 30+ pages of shared campaign memory, designed the operating plan, maintained running memory, and created a legislative provenance redline.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx explicitly preserves collective credit: the direct co-founder and web-infrastructure claim does not convert campaign accomplishments into a solo claim; campaign strategy and policy outcomes remain collective work.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx distinguishes implementation design from adoption and completion by stating that the designs do not establish City-agency adoption or completion of every planned coalition component.

apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx separates the completed cold-shell phase from the later Phase Two proposal and unused 2019 appropriation, calibrates the general-contractor title against the packet label, credits architecture, preservation, and trade work collectively, and does not imply licensed trade work.
apps/www/src/content/work/wowlist.mdx describes WOWList as co-built and limits its historical database snapshot to archive scale rather than attendance, current use, or impact.
apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx identifies Jamie's independent prototype while expressly denying commission, formal submission, or official City-service status.
findings: Direct action remains visible across the selected cases without absorbing coalition, neighborhood, architectural, trade, or product collaborators' work.
Artifact creation, delivery, situated use, institutional adoption, public outcome, and causal impact are repeatedly separated through explicit anti-claims.
The packet cannot establish private collaborator intent or undocumented divisions of work, and the candidate does not claim that it can.
evals.recommended_next_move: Strengthen the direct action and narrow the unearned collective or causal inference.

evals.title: Chad-lens hiring clarity and future-facing offer
evidence: apps/www/src/components/Hero.tsx states the target role as Technical Project Manager - Product Operations & Implementation and the owned outcome as creating operating structure for complex public-facing teams.
apps/www/src/components/Hero.tsx specifies the work Jamie can own: scope clarification, dependency coordination, visible decisions and risks, launch support, and durable workflows and handoffs.
apps/www/src/components/Hero.tsx supplies clear next actions through View role-fit proof, View resume, and Selected work.

apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx translates the offer into inspectable operating responsibilities including delivery coordination, blocker detection, planning cycles, decision frameworks, cross-functional dependencies, onboarding materials, reporting, and iterative improvement.

apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx maps the offer to specific proof surfaces, including FairRentNYC campaign memory, CallNYC resident guidance, WOWList's community-event system, and 196 / Sunday Dinner onboarding and continuity.

apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx gives an accurate referral-ready formulation: Jamie seeks technical project management, product operations, and implementation work and can own the connective layer of requirements, dependencies, workflows, risk, decision records, launch support, onboarding, and maintainable handoffs.
findings: The role, owned work, intended end, and proof path are immediately legible without invented authority.
Actor, action, and usable result are specific, while case-study boundaries prevent the hiring argument from depending on unearned adoption or impact claims.
The future-facing offer and next action are clear across the homepage, role-fit page, and about page.
This evaluation does not establish universal employer fit or permission to publish any held claim.
evals.recommended_next_move: Make the strongest approved action and end more specific without inflating ownership.

evals.title: Morse and Sack lenses preserve embodied and recursive intelligence
evidence: apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx explicitly connects participatory media and social software to present practice through code, interfaces, prototypes, installations, gatherings, and public situations used to understand systems by entering them.

apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx makes embodied inquiry operational at 196 / Sunday Dinner: invitations, recurring meals, orientation, shared space, logistics, and follow-through functioned as an interface that enabled continued participation.

apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx states a reconstructable recursive sequence: follow relationships across systems, expose hidden structure, test source-backed analysis through a prototype or usable process, test it with people in real settings, and use that encounter for further learning.

apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx demonstrates that sequence concretely: administrative constituent-services data was analyzed, reorganized into issue-oriented pathways and district context, embodied in an independent resident-facing prototype, and bounded by explicit source and institutional limitations.

apps/www/src/content/work/wowlist.mdx connects community vocabulary and informal organizing networks to followable keyword surfaces implemented with Django, PostgreSQL / PostGIS, and Ember.js for use by real organizers.

apps/www/src/content/work/196-sunday-dinner.mdx connects hospitality, trust, onboarding, facilitation, documentation, and continuity to repeatable operations across 300+ gatherings and 20+ resident artists while protecting person-level records.

docs/knowledge-bank/eval-lenses.md explicitly identifies the Morse and Sack lenses as contemporary editorial instruments derived by Jamie Burkart and Codex, not quotations, testimonials, or current endorsements by Margaret Morse or Warren Sack.
findings: Artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain visibly connected to present operating work rather than appearing as ornamental biography.
The packet provides multiple concrete recursive sequences from relational observation to working form, situated encounter, and bounded learning.
Interpretive language remains subordinate to a clear hiring path stated in apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx and apps/www/src/components/Hero.tsx.
No literal endorsement by Margaret Morse or Warren Sack is inferred; the lens contract expressly disclaims it.
evals.recommended_next_move: Restore one concrete threshold where embodied inquiry and recursive systems practice remain visible.
